description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between accuracy, measured in percentage, and token count for different models: CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The horizontal axis displays the model names – CoD, CCoT, and CoUT – in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, has a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. A secondary vertical axis on the right, labeled “Token Count”, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 100. There are three bars for each model, each a different color: red, gray, orange, and light blue for CoD; red, gray, orange, and green for CCoT; and red, gray, orange, and light blue for CoUT. The red bars represent values of approximately 91.19, 88.50, and 80.89, respectively. The gray bars have values of approximately 88.40, 80.89, and 676.85. The orange bars have values of approximately 534.24, 445.91, and 354.46. The light blue and green bars have values of approximately 445.91 and 354.46, and 534.24 and 445.91, respectively. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
